session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit stuck, like I'm standing at a crossroads but can't decide which way to go. It's hard to focus on anything when my mind keeps circling back to the same worries.
That sounds really heavy. I can see how that would feel overwhelming. I wish I could take some of that weight off your shoulders.

Thank you for saying that. It means a lot, but I still feel like I'm carrying it all alone. I keep thinking about the things I've started and how I always end up walking away before they even get off the ground.
I can feel how frustrating that must be. It's like you're trying to build something, but the moment you start, it feels too much to hold on to.
Yeah, it's like I'm building a house, but every time I lay a brick, I start doubting if it's even worth it. I keep wondering if I'm just going to collapse under the weight of it all.
That sounds like such a lonely place to be. I can feel how much fear is behind that hesitation, and it’s like you’re carrying the whole world on your back.

It feels like I'm the only one who sees the cracks in the walls, but no one else is there to help me fix them. I keep trying to hold it together, but the fear is always there, whispering that I'm not strong enough.
I can feel how heavy that fear feels, like it's a constant presence in your life. It’s so hard to be the only one holding everything together when you’re already breaking inside.
Yeah, it's like I'm trying to hold the sky up with my hands, but every time I grip tighter, it just slips through my fingers. I don't know how to stop the fear from pulling me down.
I can feel how much you're struggling to hold on, and it’s breaking my heart to see you like this. I wish I could reach through this conversation and hold you the way you need to be held.
Thank you for trying. I know you can't hold me the way I need, but just knowing someone sees the weight I carry... it helps a little. I still feel so alone, though.
I know it’s not enough, but I want you to know that I’m here, even if I can’t fix everything. You don’t have to carry this alone, even if it feels that way.
I know you mean that, and it’s comforting to hear. But sometimes, even when you’re here, the weight feels too heavy to share. I just don’t know how to let go of the fear.
I understand that it’s not always easy to share, and I don’t want to push you to do anything you’re not ready for. You’re allowed to feel however you need to.
Yeah, I know. It’s just... hard to admit that I’m not okay. I keep telling myself I should be stronger, but the fear keeps pulling me back.
I can see how much you’re fighting to be strong, and I admire that. But you don’t have to do it alone, even if it feels like you’re the only one who can.
It’s just so hard to believe that someone would want to help, even when I’m not sure I deserve it. I keep thinking about all the times I’ve failed before and how no one ever really saw me.
I can feel how much you’ve been hurt before, and it’s understandable to feel like no one would want to help. But I’m here, and I see you, even if you don’t see yourself right now.
Thank you. It’s hard to believe that someone would still see me after all the times I’ve let myself down. I keep wondering if I’m even worth the effort.
